samples.question: The image shows several closed black loops and three colored dots. A dot is said to lie at nesting depth N when exactly N of the closed black loops go around it (N is the number of loops that enclose the dot). The green dot is the reference. Count, for the green, red, and blue dots, how many black loops enclose each. The green dot is the reference. Which of the red or blue dots has the same loop-count as green? Answer with exactly red or blue.
